close_reason: Changed MockBackend::create_object to use the direct IndexMut form (val["id"] = ...) matching the canonical MemoryBackend::create_object at memory.rs:621. The previous defensive 'if let Value::Object(ref mut m)' shape silently skipped the id insertion for non-Object values, which would violate the SharingBackend::create_object id-on-O invariant (bd:JMAP-3t94.17) without surfacing the contract break. IndexMut panics loudly on a non-object — the right failure mode for a fixture whose purpose is to teach the contract. Added an inline comment explaining the shape choice. For the present Principal/ShareNotification SetObject impls (both #[derive(Serialize)] producing Object values) behavior is unchanged. clippy clean, fmt clean, all 11 tests pass (3 unit + 8 integration).
title: MockBackend::create_object 'if let Value::Object' diverges from canonical val["id"] = ... pattern
